shortDescription: Interface with dnsmadeeasy.com (a DNS hosting service)

options.name: account_key
options.description: Account API Key.

options.name: account_secret
options.description: Account Secret Key.

options.name: autoFailover
options.description: If true, fallback to the primary IP address is manual after a failover. If false, fallback to the primary IP address is automatic after a failover.

options.name: contactList
options.description: Name or ID of the contact list that the monitor notifies. The default V('') means the Account Owner.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain to work with. Can be the domain name (for example V(mydomain.com)) or the numeric ID of the domain in DNS Made Easy (for example V(839989)) for faster resolution.

options.name: failover
options.description: If V(true), add or change the failover. This is applicable only for A records.

options.name: httpFile
options.description: The file at the Fqdn that the monitor queries for HTTP or HTTPS.

options.name: httpFqdn
options.description: The fully qualified domain name used by the monitor.

options.name: httpQueryString
options.description: The string in the httpFile that the monitor queries for HTTP or HTTPS.

options.name: ip1
options.description: Primary IP address for the failover. Required if adding or changing the monitor or failover.

options.name: ip2
options.description: Secondary IP address for the failover. Required if adding or changing the failover.

options.name: ip3
options.description: Tertiary IP address for the failover.

options.name: ip4
options.description: Quaternary IP address for the failover.

options.name: ip5
options.description: Quinary IP address for the failover.

options.name: maxEmails
options.description: Number of emails sent to the contact list by the monitor.

options.name: monitor
options.description: If V(true), add or change the monitor. This is applicable only for A records.

options.name: port
options.description: Port used by the monitor.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Protocol used by the monitor.

options.name: record_name
options.description: Record name to get/create/delete/update. If O(record_name) is not specified; all records for the domain are returned in "result" regardless of the state argument.

options.name: record_ttl
options.description: Record's "Time-To-Live". Number of seconds the record remains cached in DNS servers.

options.name: record_type
options.description: Record type.

options.name: record_value
options.description: Record value. HTTPRED: <redirection URL>, MX: <priority> <target name>, NS: <name server>, PTR: <target name>, SRV: <priority> <weight> <port> <target name>, TXT: <text value>". If O(record_value) is not specified; no changes are made and the record is returned in RV(ignore:result) (in other words, this module can be used to fetch a record's current ID, type, and TTL).

options.name: sandbox
options.description: Decides if the sandbox API should be used. Otherwise (default) the production API of DNS Made Easy is used.

options.name: sensitivity
options.description: Number of checks the monitor performs before a failover occurs where Low = 8, Medium = 5,and High = 3.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the record should exist or not.

options.name: systemDescription
options.description: Description used by the monitor.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
